publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Presents the front cover, title page, or splash screen of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Approach to the Formation of Requirements for the Design of the Aircraft with Increased Load Capacity and Flight Range
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The almost sixfold growth in air cargo transportation that has taken place over seventeen years, their trends and future laws on emissions and noise requirements make it possible to create a modern cargo aircraft with increased range and carrying capacity. In this work, it is proposed to consider the design features of such an aircraft, to form requirements for it.

articleTitle: Critical Information Infrastructure Facility Status Monitoring: Risk Potential of the Process
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the issues of data mining and building on their basis predictive models for systems of diagnostics and monitoring of the technological process of facilities of critical information infrastructure. The paper considers a method to information analysis for the construction of instant models of forecasting parameters of technological process with consideration, detailing coefficients of multiple-scale wavelet transformation. An example of the use of the proposed approach for prediction and assessment of the risk potential of the temperature of the feed water behind the high-pressure heater in the power unit of the NPP is presented.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment and Cyber Security of Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of cybersecurity risk assessment for process control systems (APCS) of critical facilities. Using the example of APCS for NPP, the internal and external context of risk assessment is considered. Two methods are given: for the development life cycle stage and the APCS operation stage.

articleTitle: Designing Ecosystem Business Models: a Multi-Proj ect Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The author considers the controlled process of designing and functioning ecosystem business models, carried out by applying a multi-project approach, which implies the formation of conjugated and complementary projects that are implemented in a complex manner. A model for creating and managing an ecosystem and a methodical approach for evaluating the effectiveness of an ecosystem's functioning is proposed.

articleTitle: Forming Opinions in Social Networks: The Confrontation of Several Information Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The model of mixed types of agents in social networks is considered. For this model, the problems of information control and confrontation are solved. Two cases of confrontation are simulated: with the information interaction of network agents (the joint dynamics of their opinions and actions) and without information interaction. Equilibria are calculated for these situations.

articleTitle: System Analysis of Digital Ecosystem of Russian Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the methods that may be used to set up a science-based digital ecosystem for agriculture; these methods are based on the ideas proposed by A. Kitov and Academician V. Glushkov about a national automated information system (NAIS) for information collection and processing for accounting, planning, and management in the national economy, and substantiated by mathematical modeling. We focus on the need to ontologically integrate two basic digital ecosystem platforms: one for production and another for research and education.

articleTitle: OPERATOR System: Control, Monitoring, and Diagnostics of Software and Hardware in Instrumentation and Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper describes the system of control, monitoring, and diagnostics (SHA) included in the OPERATOR integration platform for instrumentation and control systems. The article presents the architecture of the SHA and considers different types and ways of diagnostics, monitoring, and control implemented within the system. The work pays special attention to the diagnostics integrity and configuration of an instrumentation and control system.

articleTitle: Forecasting Financial Time Series Based on the Ensemble Method
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The study considers methods for forecasting financial time series. We construct an ensemble forecast based on the linear forecast, ETS forecast, and neural forecast methods. Thereupon, we evaluate the quality of the forecast based on the confidence coefficients.

articleTitle: On the Availability Property and Its Metric for NPP IACS
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers some vital cybersecurity issues regarding industrial control. Proposing more realistic confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) triad, the article advocates availability as the significant property for industrial automation and control systems (IACS) and the associated problem of availability assessment to be the most urgent. The challenges arising during the IACS availability assessment are highlighted. The results of the analysis of availability interpretations in international regulatory documents are presented; the IEC 62443 definition is proved to be the most appropriate for the quantitative availability assessment. The availability reference model with such domains as Time-dependent parameters, Delay, Platform, System, Function, and Availability metric is proposed. Using this model, the availability metric based on the time of fulfillment of IACS functions, or delay, as a measure is derived, and the technique for its calculation according to the system domain is discussed as well.

articleTitle: Models, Algorithms and Software Complexes for Operational Monitoring of the Software Quality of the Compressor Station of an Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: For the operational monitoring of the quality of the DSS software for planning and operational management of the compressor facilities, in the article developed mathematical models, algorithms and software complexes. The developed models based on the use of the apparatus of system dynamics, graph theory and neural networks; models allow real-time monitoring of changes in the quality characteristics of the DSS and, when quality characteristics values beyond the specified range, promptly issue recommendations for correcting the defective situation that has arisen.

Author Keywords: automated control system of the compressor station

articleTitle: A Model of Crop Yield Increase Management
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This is a proposed model for managing an agricultural enterprise based on the choice of technologies for efficiency increasing. The work considers the range of such technologies. Calculations are given on the example of one of the technologies. The main task is to identify agronomic, technical, technological, and other factors that affect crop yields for potential scaling and further development of crop production.

articleTitle: Linearized Model of Volatile Equilibrium in Real Economics
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We develop a theory connecting leverage and volatility in almost the same way as private goods volumes are in dual interconnection with their prices. But the corresponding (substantially dynamical non-linear) theory is technically too complex both for operating and for results understanding, so here we develop a substantially simplified bi-linear isomorphic to general volatile equilibrium model but using only matrixes and 3-dimensional tensors instead of functional spaces and multidimensional phase diagrams. Regardless of the difficulties expected in the general case, this analytical system is appeared to be exactly solvable under some acceptable conditions.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of Control Systems According to the Criterion of Minimum Loss from the Effects of Atmospheric Pollutants
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The formulation of the problem of improving software quality for decision support and management systems according to the criterion of minimum losses from harmful effects of atmospheric pollutants has been developed. An approach to compiling a system of nonlinear differential equations in the form of Cauchy, characterizing the change in the quality of software, is proposed. The results will be used to improve environmental monitoring systems for the state of the atmosphere.

articleTitle: Organization of Production Based on Auctions
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Algorithms of network organization of interaction of the association of enterprises engaged in production are considered. Previously, a scheme of such interaction was proposed on the principle of multiple auctions, through which the distribution of functions for executing an order for production is determined. Schematic diagrams in the form of codes for the implementation of the proposed scheme of simulation procedures are given.

articleTitle: Information and Model Support for Decarbonization Management in the Russia Energy Sector
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The approaches are discussed to develop a model and information complex for scientific and methodological support of strategic decisions on the decarbonization of the Russian economy and energy sector. Such a complex is based on the task of optimizing the technological structure of the fuel and energy balance, as the main tool for cross-sectoral management of decarbonization at the national and regional levels.

articleTitle: Scenario Models Based on a Digital Portrait of a Person
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article is devoted to the study of the problems of developing cognitive models of personality psychological makeup based on digital portrait data. The authors present results of the analysis of data collection technologies which are used to form digital portraits of a person and the problems of personal data security in the network and research scenario study of the developed graph cognitive model of the personality psychological makeup and the processes of informational influence on it.

articleTitle: Sanctions and Modeling of the Financial Stability of Companies
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of modeling the consequences of economic sanctions for companies is considered. The introduction of economic sanctions against the economy of a country leads to a sharp change in the conditions of economic activity and business of companies. Companies have to adapt to the “new reality”, make non-standard management decisions and support measures. Under these conditions, the task of studying the impact of sanctions on the financial stability and solvency of companies becomes relevant. Another important task is to model and evaluate the effects of various countermeasures aimed at maintaining financial stability. It is shown that in the context of the application of sanctions, the direct method based on dynamic modeling of the company's financial indicators and cash flows is preferable to the indirect method based on the calculation of a set of coefficients using statistical data. The article describes software tools for building a production and financial model of a company based on the TEO-INVEST software package. An illustrative example shows the methodology for using it to predict the dynamics of the financial performance of an enterprise and the choice of management decisions.

articleTitle: Some Issues of Assessing the Quality of Debugging Software Systems of Critical Information Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the actual problem of debugging software critical information infrastructure systems. The paper offers an approach to the software quality assessment of CII systems, which defines the main stages of debugging and is based on applying models and methods within a multi-stage iterative process of obtaining programs of a given quality using generalized indicators. The generalized indicators composition will determine by the stages of debugging work during a multi-stage iterative process. Comparing groups of quality indicators of process sequence ensures efficient use of debugging techniques and tools.

articleTitle: Countering Fake News with Contagious Inoculation and Debunking: A Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Our earlier study considered a mathematical model of the spread of a false message in the population when it is countered with inoculation and debunking. Inoculation was assumed to be non-contagious; that is, an inoculated individual was assumed to be unable to extend their resistance to fake news to other members of the population. It was shown that non-contagious inoculation and debunking, even taken together, are ineffectual against the spread of fake news. Now we present a model with inoculation performed with a contagious game. This means that psychological resistance against manipulation techniques is conferred on players of the game such that thereby inoculated individuals communicate their positive experience of gaming to other individuals, thus contributing to a wider inoculation of the population. The model considers the process in which a fake news message is published once and spreads as a rumor by the spreaders, that is, by deceived individuals. Debunking begins after the publication and is carried out continuously by the mass media and by skeptics, i.e., individuals who have internalized the debunking message. The mathematical model is studied numerically. Experiments show that the number of fake news spreaders remains relatively low only if the effectiveness of inoculation is very high.

articleTitle: Product Traceability Digital Tool Powered by Mathematical Model for Logistics Digital Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper discusses a mathematical model for establishing a single digital logistics platform as a link between all participants in the added-value creation chain, including producers, resource and services suppliers, consumers, and logistics companies. This demonstrates that the platform in question is an opportunity to create digital tools for products and goods traceability throughout the entire production and logistics chain from the field to the end consumer's kitchen.

articleTitle: An Approach to Organizing Parallel Distributed Processing of Protected Information Queries in Multi-server Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The principles of organization of the Internet service designed to implement parallel processing of protected queries in large-scale distributed information systems with many processing servers are considered. The main goal of the service is to improve the rate of queries processing by using the capabilities of a multi-server environment. The application of this service for combining sequential (“pipelined”) and parallel processing of queries is described.

articleTitle: Stability and Non-Uniqueness of Equilibrium in an Open Market Model
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper we consider an open market model, where the supply and demand functions are restored by their price elasticities. We obtained the conditions on the stability and non-uniqueness of equilibrium in the model as the corollaries of the coincidence point theorems for a covering and Lipschitz continuous mappings.

articleTitle: On Initial Value Problem for Semilinear Second-order Parabolic Equations on Spheres
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper concerns the existence, uniqueness, and regularity of weak solutions to initial value problems for semilinear second-order partial differential equations on spheres are considered. The equations under consideration are parabolic and are inhomogeneous analogs of the Fischer-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov equation on spheres.

articleTitle: Uncertain Programming Models for Finding Reliably Compromise Design Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes optimization models that allow in preliminary technical objects design for obtaining the Pareto frontier that contains the values of objective functions and the level of confidence in their implementation. An example of synthesis of symmetrical two-element support structure parameters has been considered using the developed optimization models.

articleTitle: Conditions for the Application of the Mixed Financing Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers a situation in which project executors apply to the Principal (organization interested in project results) to receive finances. The Principal distributes finances among project executors only when the executors themselves invest their funds in the project. When distributing the financing fund, the Principal takes into account applications for financing projects and the number of funds that the performers allocate to implement their projects. This work determines the conditions activity such system.

articleTitle: Adaptation of Capacity Expansion Optimization Models to Study Impacts of Electrification of Heat Supply and Transport on the Low-Carbon Development of the Power Sector
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The possible ways to improve capacity expansion optimization models for planning the development of power systems to study the optimal scale of electrification of the end-use sector under strict climatic restrictions are considered. The approach to modeling the electricity and capacity balances taking into account the long-term elasticity of demand through the technologies of centralized electric heating and automobile electric transport is shown as well.

articleTitle: The Problem of Forming a Training Set for Multi-Valued Associative Memory Used in Trajectory Classification Depending on Linguistic Information about the Flight Situation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of forming a training set for a multi-valued associative memory is considered. The concept of multi-valued associative memory is a new one; it generalizes a similar notion in fuzzy neural networks. In multi-valued associative memory, both inputs and outputs and weights are elements or subsets of a lattice of linguistic variables. A multi-valued associative memory is used to decide on the aircraft control mode.

articleTitle: Entropy Evaluation of Data Flows Using an Integrative Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose an integrative approach for modelling the symbolic information flows in information-analytical systems (IAS) and obtaining entropy characteristics for information management. We combine the entropy characteristics of the evaluated multimedia objects and the entropy estimates expert's opinions into a single algorithm for identification.

articleTitle: Machine Learning. Stochastic Method of Solving the Problem of Classification with a supervised imbalanced training Set
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In machine learning with a large class imbalance in a supervised training set, a small class can be poorly found. We use Anderson's discriminant class estimates of posterior class probabilities to solve the imbalance problem. We do not change the proportions of classes in the training set, but choose the cost of classification errors from the ranges calculated from the posterior probabilities at points in the training set of a small class. Thus, we solve the problem in the framework of the stochastic method.

Author Keywords: evaluation of the posterior probability of the class

articleTitle: Microscopic Modeling of Traffic through an Intersection via a Hybrid System with Recursive Links
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A general model for the safe and correct traffic through a regulated intersection with a given road organization is introduced. The model is concretized based on a given correct car-following model extended to all possible situations when passing through an intersection. A recursive method for calculating a set of vehicles' trajectories is described.

articleTitle: Time Delay Estimation for Indoor Temperature Prediction by Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of indoor temperature prediction for further application in model predictive control synthesis was considered. The introduction of time delay for weather conditions was used to develop a simplified model of the temperature's dynamics that simulates thermal inertness of the building shell. The procedure of numerical estimation of the time delay was proposed on the basis of correlation analysis. Dataset of continuous measurements of indoor temperature and weather conditions was used in the experiment. The data were collected by the wireless network of smart sensors and local meteostation. Splitting the data into training and test samples was used to validate the accuracy of the prediction.

articleTitle: Influence Areas of Agents in Network Organizational Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Areas of influence in an organizational system with interconnected agents are considered. The presence of losses determines the interactions of each agent with others. These losses depend on the discrepancy between the strategies of the surrounding agents and the desired strategy of the agent considered. The introduction of loss functions allows one to determine the areas of an agent's influence on a group of neighboring agents. Conditions are studied when the areas of influence determine equilibria in dominant strategies.

Author Keywords: loss of agents from strategy mismatch

articleTitle: The Model for Assessing Scenarios for Managing the Economic Development of the Region
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work is devoted to considering approaches to developing scenarios for the growth of the region's gross regional product (GRP) based on models and estimates obtained using regional statistics, as well as the financial statements of regional organizations. Particular attention is paid to the substantiation of estimates of the growth of the GRP, which are of interest for decision- making by regional authorities.

articleTitle: Construction of Approximate Parametric Sets of Regulators for Weakly Nonlinear Discrete Control Problems on the Semi-axis based on the Asymptotic Expansions
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents an algorithm for constructing a set of stabilizing feedback laws for weakly perturbed nonlinear discrete control systems by using asymptotic expansions by the perturbation parameter using the SDRE approach. In this case, the gain matrix is constructed using the asymptotic expansions of the solutions of the corresponding matrix Riccati equations and the one-point matrix Padé approximations (P A). To significantly reduce the dimension of the corresponding linear systems, the Richardson extrapolation method is used to determine the P A coefficients. The constructed family of controllers ensures the stabilization of the closed-loop system for any values of the perturbation parameter on a certain interval. Numerical experiments illustrate the obtained theoretical statements.

articleTitle: Planning the Operations of a Group of Autonomous Unmanned Underwater Vehicles Based on a Carrier Vessel
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a method for calculating the work carried out as part of the monitoring of a river or water basin by a group of autonomous unmanned underwater vehicles (AUV) accompanied by a base vessel. This method is based on a two-level model. We give examples of monitoring a linear object (pipeline or cable) and randomly located inspection objects.

articleTitle: The Internet Shutdown during the Protest: a Model of Changing the Network Structure with an Adjustable Level of Continuity of Connections
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper introduces a new approach to modeling Internet shutdown during the process of protest mobilization. The central point of the approach is the sequential use of two networks, with different topologies built upon the same set of individuals. Some endogenously set proportion of connections is shared by both networks. A model of protest dynamics is built on the developed approach. Numerical experiments with the model show that the effect of shutdown depends crucially on the degree of anger that triggers the protest campaign. This anger may arise, for example, from contested elections or an act of unjustified repression. The inference from the numerical experiments is that shutdown basically stifles protest activity if the triggering anger is high, and fuels protest activity if the triggering anger is low.

articleTitle: Problems of Substantiating the Public Efficiency of High-speed Railways
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article explores the problems associated with substantiating the public efficiency of high-speed railways (HSR). The authors state that the calculation of “external” effects by specific algorithms proposed by them is a natural alternative to numerous multiplier effects, estimated to justify investments in HSR.

articleTitle: Pulse PID Controller IPIDO for Objects with Asymmetric Backlash
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The pulsed PID controller IPIDO, designed to control objects with asymmetric backlash, which is part of the multiplatform SCADA system “Sonata” of FSUE EZAN, is considered. The IPIDO regulator is used in the control circuits of a number of systems of the RBMK power unit No.3 at the Smolensk NPP

articleTitle: Methods and Models for Adapting the Russian Transport Infrastructure Under Sanctions
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An analysis was made of changes in the transport sector associated with the introduction of trade and logistics sanctions against Russia. The main directions of development of transport infrastructure and international transport corridors are considered. The operational transport and logistics solutions of the Russian business are analyzed. Top-priority issues of modernizing the transport infrastructure in the current situation are raised. In support of their solution, a set of models for adapting the transport infrastructure of Russia in the context of sanctions is proposed.

articleTitle: Computational Experiments on Back-Testing Complex Using the Forecast of Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The use of artificial neural networks to predict the price movements of derivatives and spot market instruments as part of a proprietary back-testing system.

articleTitle: Single-Factor Stress Testing of the System-Forming Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a method for conducting stress testing of enterprises in the real sector of the economy. The development includes the formulation and methodology for solving the inverse problem of stress testing and a predictive mathematical model based on data from open sources (companies' financial statements). The inverse task is to determine the characteristics of the financial and economic state of the enterprise, corresponding to various critical combinations of parameters of the financial result of its activities. Our original technique can significantly reduce the complexity and computational complexity of stress testing. We demonstrate our development by the stress testing backbone enterprises in the trade industry. The results obtained will find application in solving optimization problems for making decisions to increase the survivability of various sectors of the economy.

articleTitle: Reliability Indicators of Functioning of Distributed Systems that do not Use Restorative Redundancy Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The high level of reliability of distributed data processing systems is the most critical characteristic of such systems. The article analyzes the reliability indicators of distributed systems using operational redundancy and not using restorative redundancy.

articleTitle: Scenario Approach to Software Updates of Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The features of updating programs and data in complex networks are considered. A scenario approach to updating in large-scale distributed systems is proposed. Algorithms for generating and executing scenarios are described. The main methods of updating software and information structures of application servers, database servers, and clients are defined.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Changes in Frozen Soil Surrounding an Oil Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Global warming and local anthropogenic influence reduce the bearing capacity of permafrost soils, causing changes in the spatial position of pipelines and increasing the number of accidents. The proposed approach of changes in frozen soil offers: to convert the existing 4D array into a 2D view without losing information; to add new features that emphasize the seasonality and condition of permafrost; to predict missing parts of time series, and finally to re-analyze the temperature intervals of frozen soils.

articleTitle: The Algorithm of Searching for Critical Combinations of Events During the Welding Process in Robotic Technological Complexes
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The models and the algorithms for control the welding process in robotic complexes are considered under conditions of occurrence risk of critical combinations of events leading to emergency situations. Using the apparatus of dynamic graphs, the previously developed approach was modified by synthesizing and further analyzing new edges of the activities graph

articleTitle: Methodological Development of Socio-Economic Monitoring Information System at the Regional Economics
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to illustrate how instrumental differences in statistical assessment methods for analyzing the economic consequences of processes associated with digital transformation: a case study of local markets develops the methodology of socio-economic monitoring at the regional economics.

articleTitle: The Effect of a Change of Correction Device on the Flight Mission Capability of an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the effect of transients when the onboard navigation system correction devices are switched at boundary conditions. The cause of transients is described, as well as their effect on the readings of the onboard navigation.

articleTitle: Development of a Digital Model and a Group Control System for the Temperature State of the T-160-7 Steam Turbine when Operating in Motor Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The advantages of transferring the steam turbine T-160-7 of the PGU-450T thermal power unit to the motor mode (MM) when the CCGT operates in the GTU-CHP mode are considered. To control the temperature state of the turbine flow part, it is proposed to regulate the steam temperatures according to the group principle. A method of compiling a digital model of steam turbine compartments is proposed. The description of the control system for the temperature state of the first compartment of a steam turbine using the developed digital model is given.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Control Strategies for a Mathematical Model of Glioma Drug
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers a mathematical model of drug therapy for glioma without taking into account spatial diffusion. For the glioma model, two control strategies are compared: re-duction to a canonical controlled form, feedback linearization as a control, and application of a block approach using discontinuous controls.

articleTitle: Global-networked Synergy of Large Distributed Systems with Control
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The Global Computer Environment (GCE) has become the basis for increasing the size of large distributed systems with control. The conditions for their growth are determined by the positive synergy of the network effect according to Metcalf's law. The paper shows that heterogeneity is the main source of negative GCE synergy. Excessive growth in the cost of distributed systems is associated with the combinatorial complexity of the functional integration of initially heterogeneous network resources. Heterogeneity and intra-system imbalances of GCE development activate secondary sources of negative synergy. The paper presents an original approach to studying the fundamental intra-system regularities of GCE development as an integral object. - For the first time, the ways to eliminate the GCE intra-system negative synergy are shown, which open up opportunities to minimize the costs of creating and developing arbitrarily large distributed systems in GCE.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of Mixed Type Failures in the Aircraft Electromechanical Actuator Gear by Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We proposed a method for designing the algorithms to determine the aircraft electromechanical actuators (EMA) technical condition by using the neural networks to simultaneously progress failures of various physical natures. We presented the results of the computational research on determining the EMA failures associated with changes in the dry friction and backlash in the gear.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning for Air Traffic Control in Upper Airspace
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper examines strategic four-dimensional trajectory planning technology for a forward-looking air traffic control system complemented by tactical planning to overcome uncertainty due to difficult weather conditions and airspace conflicts.

articleTitle: Statement and Preliminary Solution of the Rational Applied Application Problem of Structural Identification Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The author investigates the problem of rational applied use of structural identification methods under conditions of prior structural uncertainty. The article contains this problem statement for the pre-project stages of creating an automatic stabilization system with the required properties. For a clear and precise understanding of the problem, the author formulates the principal research contradiction, the problem's central question, the research's main hypothesis, and the study purpose. The article contains the preliminary solution to the formulated problem.

Author Keywords: automatic stabilization system with the required properties

articleTitle: On Some Problems in the Investment Sphere
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article summarizes some data from authoritative sources on the problems of investment activity, both primary and specific, characteristic of certain types of investments.

articleTitle: Eco-economic Smart Business Management in a Large-scale Oil Company
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: the article deals with the problems of evaluation of investment projects efficiency related to the environmental and economic management of big businesses in an oil-producing Russian holding company. We studied the criteria for selecting investment program proposals for company's forecasting activities. The article analyzes the criteria for investment process efficiency aimed at implementing projects of environmental reconstruction, technical re-equipment and further development of the oil business. It is recommended to carry out operational and medium-term planning in a format in which the main production, economic and environmental indicators for the previous first three years of the enterprise's activity are known and the planned indicators for the fourth year are identified. Based on the optimal values of the criteria application for the functions of pure and mixed strategies for managing investments in production and the environment, the indicators of the economic attractiveness of alternative projects for the development of the oil business are calculated. This makes it possible to ensure a harmonious, sustainable development of the production and economic activities of the oil-producing holding company in the planned time.

articleTitle: Copyright
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Presents the copyright information for the conference. May include reprint permission information.

articleTitle: Methods for Reducing Temperature Heating in Supersonic Aircraft Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we consider promising methods for combating the temperature heating of an aircraft during a long flight, as well as heating the structure of the aircraft itself. This kind of load leads to a decrease in operational and technological properties, as well as a change in frequency characteristics.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Quadcopter Stabilization System Using a Neural Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Setting up classical PID controllers works for systems with a priori known properties and parameters. After changing the characteristics of an object, such regulators may not be able to stabilize its control variables and break the specified limits e.g. when the angular velocity is exceeded as a result of an engine malfunction. This paper presents an algorithm for the neural stabilization of a quadcopter. We use reinforcement learning method to enable adaptation of the agent during the control process. The quadcopter is simulated in a virtual environment and trained in a series of episodes with sequential assessment of its movement efficiency and tuning neural network parameters. A comparison of the transient characteristics of the quadcopter in various conditions showed that the neural network controller surpasses the classical PID controller by several significant criteria.

articleTitle: Logical Aspects of the Transportation Services Catalog
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to constructing an intelligent digital catalog of transport services based on the logic of predicates is proposed. The structure and fragments of the knowledge base of the catalog are given, in particular, the transport network, cargo classification, technologies, essential services, and elements of the logistic scheme for various stages of its formation. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Information Modeling Based on Monitoring the Entropy Analysis of Text Corpora in the Network
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents a description and properties of a linguistic model for text analysis. The monitoring of entropy analysis of text corpora in the network for a given information structure is carried out, the results of the content analysis of hieroglyphs are presented.

articleTitle: Model for Predicting the Main Indicators of Road Transport System Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article considers a set of mathematical models based on the system-dynamic approach. We have developed a set of interrelated models of system dynamics, which makes it possible to predict the leading indicators of road safety in Russia. We selected indicators based on regulatory documents of the State Traffic Inspectorate of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia. The results will be used to improve the software for traffic control systems.

articleTitle: Aircraft Fuselage, Wing, and Empennage Design Weight Model Based on Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the issues of determining the mass of some of the main aircraft units: wing, fuselage, and fins. A method for predicting the mass of aggregates based on regression analysis is presented. The dependence of the mass of the construction of the units on the geometric parameters is used.

articleTitle: NPP APCS Archive Data Scheme Optimization of Data Size and Query Execution Time for Implementation of Archive Conversion Module from Binary Data Format to PostgreSQL Database Format
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This document describes some approaches to optimization of the NPP APCS archives data scheme and its implementation in the software conversion module. This module converts two binary archive formats, developed in ICS of RAS, to PostgreSQL database format.

articleTitle: Assessments the Impact of the Central Bank Decisions on the Factors of Economic Activity Using Expert Data
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We considered the procedures and results of the expert analysis of the mutual influence of the factors of the monetary policy of the Central Bank and the indicators of economic activity. A set of primitive relationships considered the estimates of which expert means set in order to obtain impact estimates. Indirect influences we evaluated using the transitive closure of primitive connections, performed by the reflexive procedures that use recalculation operations.

Author Keywords: assessment of the influence of factors

articleTitle: Methods to Automate Planning and Regulation of Air Traffic Flows near Major Airports
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report discusses the current problems of automation of planning and control of air traffic flow near major airports, methods for optimizing the sequence and arrival time of aircraft in compliance with the required intervals and the organization of conflict-free convergence of aircraft flows for landing with the minimum necessary delay.

articleTitle: Duopolistic Competition of Digital Ecosystems-What is Behind the Switching Costs
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Digital ecosystems as infrastructures that ensure the interaction of producers and consumers have become a new reality of business environment. It raises new questions of modeling competition in information oligopolistic markets, which are dictated primarily by peculiarities of consumer behavior, an increasing role of network effect and switching costs. This paper shows the impact of switching costs in the situation when ecosystem-leader is lowering prices. Approach of joint consideration of the network effect and switching costs is also justified when analyzing the behavior of the segment of consumers prone to periodic provider changes.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of a Functional Equation for the Stochastic Optimal Control Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This work presents the approach to solving the functional equation of non-local type that appears in the study of a stochastic optimal control problem. This experience demonstrates the challenges and possible solutions in the analysis of optimal control problems with Poisson uncertainty.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of the Situation Criminalization Production and Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article analyzes criminal activity of an economic nature in case of penetration of crime into production and the system of protection against it. It is advisable to find out under what conditions it is unprofitable to steal, for which it is necessary to supplement legal studies with economic ones. The results of the analysis will help to find ways to rationally counteract crime.

Author Keywords: the possibility of minimizing damage from criminal activity

articleTitle: Categorization and Criticality Assessment of Facilities of Critical Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Assessment of the critical infrastructure (CI) criticality is an essential task in the task complex to ensure the protection of CI. The article shows the significant distinction between criticality assessment and risk assessment. Based on the concept of criticality, the paper presents the method to the categorization of CI and critical information infrastructure (CII) facilities, along with the developed procedure for identifying and categorizing CI and CII facilities. The presented method allows the development of cybersecurity procedures for various critical infrastructure facilities.

articleTitle: Assessment of Damage Value for Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This electronic document sets out an approach to assessing the damage value in determining the risks of information security in complex systems concerning the distribution of separate elements of business processes within the software/hardware system complexes and the estimation of their cost.

articleTitle: Reserved Network Software Channels for Data Exchange in Large-Scale Control Systems for APCS of NPP
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The task of reserving of network software channels for data exchange in the Top-level subsystem (TLS) of the Automated process control system (APCS) of a Nuclear power plant (NPP) is considering. The methods for solving this problem and the algorithms implemented in APCS NPP software are proposing.

Author Keywords: reserving of network data exchange channels

articleTitle: Formalized Models and Methods for Building Efficient Digital Information Funds of Intellectual Property
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The goals, objectives and criteria of the effectiveness of the creation, maintenance and use of the Digital Information Fund of Intellectual Property (DIFIP) are considered. A formalized methodology is proposed for designing DIFIPs, increasing its efficiency and quality, based on a set of interconnected models, methods and algorithms for analysis, synthesis and normalization distributed information management of DIFIP's structure; classification of databases users of patent and scientific and technical information; synthesis of optimal logical structures of the DIFIP database and thematic databases; assessing the quality of the database and ensuring the required level of data security.

Author Keywords: Digital Information Fund of Intellectual Property (DIFIP)
database of scientific and technical information
distributed information management structure of the DIFIP

articleTitle: Personalized System for Automatic Control of Blood Glucose Level
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of building a closed personalized system for automatic control of blood glucose levels based on sensor measurements of glucose levels in the interstitial space and describe a technique for selecting a group of personalized model parameters that require individual identification. Calculations based on real data and the results of applying the PD controller demonstrate the efficiency of the approach.

articleTitle: Mathematical Methods of Territorial Design
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the application of mathematical methods in the problems of territorial design on the example of designing the development of oil fields. The application of the method of sequential calculations for solving problems of location, the method of constructing networks for various purposes, algorithms for tracing communications in a heterogeneous territory, and the use of the approximation-combinatorial method for multi-extremal problems are considered.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Using Virtual Objects in Swarm Robotics
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of controlling the maneuvering of a flock of homogeneous mobile robots in a quasi-two-dimensional space using virtual objects is considered. To approximate actual conditions, the dimensions of the robots were taken into account, and restrictions on maneuvering were introduced. It presented the results of simulation modeling of typical tasks.

articleTitle: The Application Efficiency of the Hurst Exponent for the Stocks Prices Forecast
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The possibility of increasing the accuracy of forecasting stock prices by using the Hurst exponent as an additional indicator to modern forecasting methods. It was obtained confirmation of the effectiveness of the Hurst exponent application as an additional instrument for risk assessment, which allows to improve the reliability of the forecast data in large-scale investment systems. The study (more than 50 companies for the period 2016-2021) confirmed that the application of the Hurst exponent can improve forecasting results of the stock prices.

articleTitle: Application of Microwave Sensors on Vehicles for Safety, Unmanned Control and Navigation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the results of a study of the possibility of using remote Doppler microwave sensors in some transport control systems. In particular, the problems of antilock braking systems during emergency braking, autonomous navigation, and unmanned control when moving along a given route. The advantages of sensors, which consist of the direct measurement of speed and displacement, are noted.

articleTitle: Optimization on Cognitive Models
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The concept of acceptable systems with a limited level of systemic pathologies and dysfunctions is considered. The main provisions of cognitive modeling are given and the tasks of single- and multi-criteria optimization on cognitive models of systemic pathologies and dysfunctions of the region are considered.

articleTitle: Managing Two-Level Manufacturing in Transportation with Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a model of hierarchical transport corporation, in which the Executive and his subordinate factory manager (the Manager) organize two-level manufacturing. They are controlled by corporation's governance (in short, the Chief) with the Consultant. The Executive knows the capabilities of increasing manufacturing output only at own level. The Manager knows the manufacturing potential of the factory. Neither the Chief nor his Consultant knows the Executive and Manager capabilities. So the Executive can manipulate own output in order to influence the decisions of the Consultant and the Chief to growth own reward. But the Executive itself does not know the potential of the factory. This also can be used by its Manager in own favor. So, the Executive needs to learn to control the Manager. The interests of the Executive and the Manager are reflected in the model by introducing their reward functions. On the basis of this model, sufficient conditions have been found for the synthesis of a hierarchy of controllers for managing output, ensuring the use of random possibilities of its increasing. In these conditions, the Chief needs consultations with the help of a self-learning Consultant. Through these consultations, the Chief can norm the Executive's output. The Learning controller encourages the Executive, firstly, to maximize auxiliary output and, secondly, to implement an adaptive controller for the Manager. Such an adaptive controller includes planning and incentive procedures that encourage the Manager to maximize the manufacturing in the factory. The application of this approach is illustrated by the example of managing output in a car repair corporation.

articleTitle: Logic Analysis of Nudge Action in the Management of Social Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the article we formulated a mathematical statement of the problem of determining the nudge influence on the behaviour of actors. We propose an approach to identify such impacts using logical trees. Using the minimum sections of the logical tree, we complete the observed set of events to combinations that lead to the desired behavior of the actor. At the end of the article, we give one example illustrating our approach.

articleTitle: The New Silk Road: an Analysis of the Problems of Ensuring the Integrated Safety of Railway Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The current state and prospects for the development of transport infrastructure of the EAEU member states as the most important systemic participant in the international New Silk Road project are considered. An assessment of the development of terminal infrastructure is presented. An analysis of the level of its safety in light of the implementation of the EAEU Rail Transport Development Strategy has been carried out, risks have been identified and effective management decisions and priority measures aimed at preventing them from being implemented have been identified.

articleTitle: Non-finite methods of Reconstructions of Non-Classical Propositional Logic Variants based on the Theory of Structures in Control Problems of Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report explores the problem of developing a common base of mathematical support for the problem of modeling control systems for objects of great complexity. The problem of reconstructing variants of propositional logic based on structures whose elements are considered as truth values of formulas of reconstructed variants of propositional logic is considered. The reconstruction is based on the assumption that there is a homomorphism from the algebra of logic to the algebra of truth values. In the proposed version of the semantic approach to the classification of formal logical calculus as a result of the interaction of various logical moments, this interaction takes the form of an interconnection of algebraic structures on which the values of “judgments” take values, different types of measures on these structures and equivalence relations associated with them.

articleTitle: Features of Modeling the Russian Gas Industry under Global Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the features of optimization modelling of the Russian gas industry for the long term in the context of global restrictions. All production areas of the gas industry are considered - from exploration and production to processing, transportation, and liquefaction.

articleTitle: Seismological Control of Geodynamic Activity of a Hydrocarbon Deposit
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Exposure of the developed hydrocarbon deposits territories to the effects of anomalous geodynamics can have serious consequences for humans and habitat. Control technology includes operations based on the registration of signals using seismic stations combined into a seismological network and implemented on the model zone.

articleTitle: Using Partitions by Attributes for Social Control
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We focus on weakening a dangerous community. The paper investigates a problem of an external and soft control of a community. At first, we checked an assumption about the connection between the features of the vertices and the presence of an edge between the vertices was checked. Then, two models were proposed to model a dynamics - a modification of Barabaci-Albert model and a new reconnection model based on the general classical ideas, as in the Watts-Strogatz model. Within the framework of such models, the control problem was naturally reduced to the separation problem. Furthermore, we proposed greedy and stochasti algorithms to solve it. The algorithms were applied to real and synthetic data and we shown their strengths and weaknesses.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Effectiveness of Solving the Main Economic Task for 2021
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the methodology for assessing the effectiveness of solving the task of the President of Russia for 2021. The task was to restore the level of employment in the national economy. A measure of the effectiveness of solving the president's task in this article is defined as the relative change of the real GDP as the response to the elimination of the increased unemployment rate in the country due to the pandemic. The production function of the national economy is an analytical tool that allows us to assess the measure of the effectiveness of solving the task of the President of Russia to restore the level of employment in the economy. The methodology and results of constructing the production function of the Russian economy are briefly discussed at the beginning of the paper. Using a way of econometric modelling We have found that the achievement of the Russian President's goal of restoring employment in the national economy in 2021 led to increase (all other things being equal) the country's real GDP by 2.7%.

Author Keywords: production function of the national economy
measures to improve the efficiency of solving the problem of the President of Russia

articleTitle: Aircraft Components Condition Classification Using the Methods of Informative Features Selection and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report covers the algorithms for informative features selection by data mining methods in the context of the aircraft electrical motor early diagnostics where the analyzed set of controlled variable values refers to a certain class or degradation level.

articleTitle: An Approach to Decision-Making Systems' Development in Case of Accidents' Causes Figuring out in Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The author developed an approach that defines the methodological basis for creating advanced information systems. The systems are made for decision-making support during investigation of accidents' causes in large-scale systems. It bases on mathematical models of events' filters. The article includes examples of the approach's application for aviation systems.

articleTitle: Models of Complex Risk Assessment for Soil Resources of Arid Zones
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Agricultural industry deals with a complex of natural factors with their self-regulation and control mechanisms. There is always a lot of uncertainty and associated risks in natural systems. Therefore, the problem of assessing these risks arises naturally, and their correct assessment is crucial in arid zones especially. The soil resource is a central component in the complex of risk factors. It ensures production stability and significantly affects the forecast of any agricultural project. However, the assessment of the soil resource itself is a complex problem, including dozens of parameters that are rely upon each other and dynamically change. The goal of the study is to solve this problem by developing the instrument for the soil resources risk assessment. There are a remarkable number of studies describing various methods and decision support systems in agriculture including soil resources assessment methods. Nevertheless, their accuracy is still insufficient. Moreover, the most accurate models consider the soil and region's climate so finely that they can barely be adapted to another conditions. This study attempts to adapt the complex assessment method to assess the risks of soil resources. This method works fine in the field of organizational and technical systems management. Its main benefit is an easy-to-construct structure allowing to simultaneously consider the variety of relationships between the evaluated parameters, including those related to the cultivated crop. The authors have modified the method to assess risks to soil resources within a given planning horizon under conditions of probabilistic uncertainty. The paper provides an example of building a risk assessment system for soil resources in arid zones.

articleTitle: Prices and Decentralization of Control
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers some models of a two-level hierarchical system for different-degree awareness of the Center and its subsystems. The authors investigate control procedures through the distribution of resources, the output of products, and pricing. They also formulate a problem to design the mechanisms coordinating the decisions of subsystems on voluntary fulfillment of the general restrictions that is fundamentally new for hierarchical games.

articleTitle: Production Expansion in Presence of a Bank Account
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This work presents an extension of the model of optimal investment in production expansion. We introduce the possibility of having an account in a bank and reformulate the model of optimal control of production expansion to study the changes in the optimal behaviour of the producer as they face the trade-off between the risky entrepreneurship and risk-free bank account. The producer's problem is formalized as the optimal control problem which are solved using the Pontriagin's maximum principle and the Hamilton - Jacobi - Bellman equation.

articleTitle: The Architecture of Digital Enterprise in the University Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents the concept of organizational-methodological and tools support for a digital enterprise in the university infrastructure. The authors carried out the trade-off analysis for these tools. The article presents the competence matrix, performance model, organizational structure, and project team labor-division model as the artifacts of organizational-and-methodological supports for a digital enterprise.

articleTitle: Construction of an Investment Portfolio Based on Stochastic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The aim of the work is a comparative analysis of investment portfolios built based on stochastic modeling. We obtained actual stock price data of 80 Russian companies traded on the Moscow Stock Exchange for the last six years. Using it, we created simulation models.

articleTitle: The Problem of Situational Control of Continuous Production
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of automating the decision-making process in managing of continuous production is considered. Sheet glass production is chosen as an example of continuous production. Process data presents as expert knowledge in natural language. Situation models allow us to use expert knowledge about the functioning of the control object.

articleTitle: Training and Adaptation of Self-Learning Systems in the Context of Conflict Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The usage of artificial self-learning systems in the process of modelling and prediction the development of conflict interaction been studied. Such systems generalize the concept of an intelligent agent who, acting in conditions of incomplete information, improves his behavior during a computational experiment depending on the environment's reaction and using artificial intelligence technologies.

articleTitle: Output Variable Control with Signal Undefined Setpoint Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of tracking a given signal in linear non-minimum phase multidimensional systems under conditions of incomplete signal information about the state vector of the control plant model and the generator of given actions is considered. In contrast to known approaches, it is assumed that an unknown signal is applied to the input of a generator of given signal, which makes it possible to change the behavior of the job generator in real-time. For information support in the implementing of the proposed algorithms, state observers based on the theory of sliding modes and deep feedback are used.

Author Keywords: dynamic generator of a given signal

articleTitle: Diffuse Identity of Moscow Regions in Mapping in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Previous world studies in the field of urban mapping show that the construction of the identity of settlements occurs non-linearly, and with a partial degree of attachment to the real territorial demarcation. The key issue is the methodological issue of measuring and indicators of the discrepancy between the population's real and mental assessments of their living environment. We have mapped the areas of the Moscow region in the social network Vkontakte using the author's method of “grain clustering”. Network maps showed the blurring of the boundaries between the regions of the Moscow region and the attraction of their larger agglomerations and regions of Moscow. The influence of politically active groups at the federal level is shown.

articleTitle: The Problem of Automating Economic Modelling
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the article we describe the problem of automating the modeling of complex systems based on agent models. Diffi-culties arising in the description of agency tasks, their matching and research are discussed. We substantiate the necessity of automating checks with feedback on arising errors. We propose the general algorithm for automated processing of agents' models.

articleTitle: Table_of_contents
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Presents the conference table of contents.

articleTitle: Options for Regulating Traffic Flows at Intersections and Some Ways to Choose Them
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The method of controlling an intersection by jointly choosing a phase-wise traffic separation scheme and optimizing traffic light control at the required intensity of traffic flows along the directions of movement is being developed, taking into account the interaction of clusters on exit roads. The sequence of passage schemes on phases and temporal phase shifts for individual routes are optimized.

articleTitle: On One Game with the Right of the First Move with Inaccurate Information about the Partner's Goal
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report considers a model of a two-level hierar-chical system with a complex structure of transmitted information. Models of this kind can describe, for example, the process of allocating resources for a production program. The maximal guaranteed result of the top-level player who has the right of the first move is found. The structure of one of his optimal strategies is described.

Author Keywords: allocation of resources for the production program

articleTitle: Technoscape: a Multi-Agent Model of All-Human Global Web
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A model of spatial and temporal coevolution of a system of trading and producing agents is suggested. These agents can conditionally be mapped to producing and trading firms, while no difference between production and trade is suggested: what is produced is immediately traded. The model is both local and non-local from the perspective of how agents interact with each other and the territory. The model shows a phenomenon of “city” formation; a city is just a grid cell with a high concentration of agents. These cities experience complex coevolution.

articleTitle: Development And Research Of An Algorithm Based On The “Direct Collocation” Method
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The presentation considers the creation of software for solving the problem of finding a fuel-optimal trajectory of climbing and accelerating to supersonic speed of maneuvering aircraft. The search for trajectories of this type is relevant at the preliminary design stage, when it is required to determine the combat radius of the aircraft under development.

articleTitle: Quantifying the Effect of COVID-19 Vaccination Strategies: Agent-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper we discuss an approach for estimation the human toll of COVID-19 epidemic based on an agent-based model. First we present the model and calibrate the parameters using Moscow population statistical data. Using QALY approach we quantify the cost associated with epidemic and investigate the influence of superspreader vaccination on the integral QALY loss, total cases, recoveries, hospitalizations and lethal cases.

articleTitle: Direct and Inverse Optimization Problems in a Gas Deposit Model
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A continuous dynamic model for the development of a gas field is studied. Two mathematical problems are posed, solved and analyzed. In the direct problem, we are looking for the maximum accumulated profit on a set of temporary functions of a certain type. In the inverse optimization problem, we define the entire set of planning horizons. We subject the assigned tasks to a comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: Randomization of the Options Portfolio In Tasks Optimization by CC-Var on the Aggregate of Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report continues research on the problems of using the continuum VaR criterion (CC-VaR) in financial markets. We are talking about the application of CC-VaR on a combination of one two-dimensional and two one-dimensional theoretical single-period options markets, partially interconnected by underlying assets. Construction of the optimal cc-var A combined portfolio is conducted based of discrepancies in relative returns within each market and between markets, and the requirements of the criterion should be maintained.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Methodological Aspects of Assessing the Level of Information Development in the World and the EAEU Countries
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article's purpose was to build a connection between indicators of measuring the information economy, and to create a comprehensive methodology for assessing the informatization of the world economy and EAEU countries. The international system of information economy measurement indicators, such as the Digital Economy and Society Index, Network Readiness Index, Knowledge Economy Index, Economy Digitalization Index, ICT Development Index, Global Digital Competitiveness Index, and e-Government Development Index, was considered. The positioning of the EAEU countries in the world system of classification of development of the information economy has been clarified. A new system of indicators, considering the level of clustering, and the development of innovative and scientific resources was proposed. The correlation of the indices “Level of cluster development,” “Innovation potential,” “Quality of scientific research institutes and “ Average index of information economy development” was considered. The graphical model of the dependence between the indices of the information economy of individual countries was built.

articleTitle: Selection of the Object Model in Optimizing the Prognostic Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper solves the problem of dependence of the approximating object model on the efficiency of the prognostic control system. Parametric optimization is performed for a system with a predictive PID controller. The significant influence of the choice of model on the quality of regulation is shown, and recommendations are given for the object model on the possible degree of simplification.

Author Keywords: oxygen content in boiler flue gases

articleTitle: Distribution of Economic Policy Instruments in the Russian Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to determine the degree of influence of a set of classical instruments of macroeconomic policy on the development of the Russian economy. It is customary to set and solve the problem of resource allocation, to look for sources of resources for the development of a large-scale system, but the way the impact of government policies and tools is distributed is usually not taken into account either in modern growth models or in economic development planning. The research methodology includes, in addition to macroeconomic analysis, the regression analysis based on the Gretl 2020b program module, which allows you to determine the distribution of the impact of macroeconomic policy instruments on the growth rate and the gross value added of Russian economy. The result of the study is that in the period 2001–2019.
