There is no significant impact of inflation on the rate of economic growth, with a significant impact of the level of monetization and a significant impact of the high key interest rate that hinders growth. It reduced opportunities for the development of the “high tech”, and contributed to the development of the basic industry. The level of monetization had a positive effect on the growth rate and on the development of elements of the structure of the Russian economy. This revealed circumstance leads to the need for a differentiated selection of economic policy measures with a mandatory assessment of the sensitivity of the elements of the economic structure and general dynamics parameters to them. This study shows one of the options for a possible assessment of the distribution of economic policy measures in their impact on the functioning of economy by the growth rate and the gross value added.

articleTitle: Problems of Production Program Formation for Russian Civil Aircraft Industry: Products Diversification and Unification
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers the factors that affect the economic efficiency of production program diversification of the Russian aircraft industry of autonomous development of Russian aviation. The article concentrates on the problems of small markets and the degree of product unification. The main contribution of this article is to present mathematical models for choosing rational solutions.

articleTitle: Model of Dynamics the Inflation Macro Indicators Taking into Account External Influences
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A developmental model reflects the dynamics of macro indicators of the Russian economy, such as the consumer price index, the ruble exchange rate, the dynamics, and the annual GDP index in the medium term. When building the model, we used expert hypotheses, patterns, and statistical data. To build a model, we used a phenomenological approach, which consists in formalizing the properties of the observed reaction of the economy to external influences and the subsequent verification of the resulting model.

Author Keywords: the model of dynamics of macro-indicators
the reaction of the economy to external influences

articleTitle: Harmonizing Social and Production Indicators in the Way to Technological Sovereignty
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Achieving national technological sovereignty is a complex problem that combines the tasks of social and industrial development. The article contains the results of a study on elaborating mechanisms for harmonizing the target social and economic indicators leading to technological sovereignty as a general purpose.

articleTitle: The Neural Network Algorithm for Decision Support During Control of the Welding Process by Robotic Complexes
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes an algorithm for solving the problem of controlling the welding process in robotic technological complexes according to the quality criterion of the products. The statement of the problem is given and the model of system dynamics by J. Forrester is considered. Welding quality indicators in robotic complexes were used as system levels. Functional dependencies are taken by using the mathematical apparatus of artificial neural networks, in particular, radial basis functions that allow for rigid interpolation. The introduction of the models and algorithms discussed in the article will improve the quality of products using robotic technological complexes.

articleTitle: The Selection of the Comparative Evaluation Method of the Effectiveness of the Insurance Company Branches
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors propose the comparative analysis of the various ranking methods usage to determine the effectiveness of the branches of an extensive insurance company. In turn, the effectiveness of the branches is considered in terms of dependence on various indicators of the insurance company activity.

Author Keywords: ranking of the values of indicators

articleTitle: On Some Issues of Mathematical Modeling of Various Approaches to Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The enlarged model of comparison of various concepts of education (culturally appropriate and nature-like) in compulsory secondary school proposed earlier by the author is supplemented by taking into account feedback on the health of students, which makes it possible to move from the appropriate modeling of the school “in the moment” to modeling it in time dynamics.

Author Keywords: the impact of the chosen concept of learning on the academic success and health of students

articleTitle: Methods of Work Scheduling for Enterprises with Slipway Assembly of Products
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The author considers the problems of building work schedules for enterprises with slipway assembly products. The structure of such enterprises may include several production units, which manufacture parts used for assembly on slipways of manufactured products. The author suggests methods for constructing work schedules for such enterprises.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Use of Fail-Safe Archives of Magnetic Media on the Reliability Indicators of Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A critical property of distributed data processing systems is the high level of reliability of such systems. A practical solution to this problem is to place copies of archives of magnetic media in the nodes of the system. These archives are used to restore data destroyed during the processing of requests to this data. The paper shows the impact of the use of archives on the reliability indicators of distributed systems.

articleTitle: Determining Effective Strategies For Information Warfare In Consolidated And Polarized Populations
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A propaganda battle model is considered that has the form of a system of integral-differential equations. The population in this model consists of two groups of individuals, one of which cannot receive propaganda through the media. These opposing groups (one of which has propaganda superiority) can choose one of three strategies for information confrontation: decreasing intensity (in which the media broadcasting intensity decreases over time), increasing intensity, and flat intensity (the media broadcasting intensity remains constant throughout the confrontation). The effectiveness of each strategy is studied for different model parameters, numerical calculations are carried out, and meaningful conclusions are made regarding the optimal strategy for each group in each case.

articleTitle: Reduction of Carbon Footprint: Digital Management Strategies
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the national- and collective-level progress in achieving a long-term objective, greenhouse gas (GHG) reduction, thanks to economic decarbonization strategies. The problem resides in preliminary measurements within their sovereign boundaries. This approach does not include and does not consider the direct relationship of these emissions to all materials and processes that products and services made, or provided by various companies from various countries, are involved in throughout the life cycle. Because of this, up-to-date statistical data on international trade, procurement, and supply is a well-regarded tool to take estimations of carbon “embodiment” into products into account, which manufacturers from various countries place on the global market. It creates a deep-structured big data infrastructure for an analytic survey to be carried out based on accurate information. A subject of such a survey would be problems of carbon footprint reduction management due to the development of new low-carbon economic technologies. The issue will focus on the standardization of objectives and methods of operational analysis and strategic planning. The present paper aims to develop a concept to cover SMART targeting and managing decarbonization and carbon footprint reduction projects.

articleTitle: About one Approach to Inventory Management in Hierarchical Warehouse Systems with Restrictions on Warehouse Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Inventory management problems are considered in the presence of restrictions on the capacity of warehouses and the problems of managing multi-product stocks in hierarchical warehouse systems with restrictions on the capacity of warehouses at constant demand. Models and methods proposed for solving these problems allow, following the existing demand and restrictions on the capacity of warehouses, to determine the time and volumes of replenishment of all warehouses located at various levels of such a warehouse system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vaccine Dose Effectiveness in Different Age Groups of the Population: a Conceptual Mathematical Model of Lymphopoiesis
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents a conceptual mathematical model of lymphopoiesis that describes the dynamics of the T cell and B cell immune response after the single introduction of the vaccine. Results indicate that effective immune response requires different vaccine dosages for different age groups.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning of Crane Trolley for Smooth Payload Transportation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of stabilization of a given position of a transport crane trolley under the presence of uncertainties in model. To reduce the payload oscillations, we form a trajectory as the sum of the sigmoid function and the integral of the angular coordinate. The developed trajectory is tracked using the control law, where we also apply the sigmoid function.

articleTitle: About Return on Investment of Top Market Cap Cryptocurrency Portfolio
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this work we give the results of calculations of the return on investment for cryptocurrency portfolios based on the market cap in 2014 – 2021. We try to find a simple profitable and low-risk strategy for an average investor who has only access to the open statistical data. There is a widely known strategy of this sort - to regularly buy bitcoin, so that in several years it gives profit according to the historical data. We investigate if there is such a strategy based on altcoin portfolios. We find that the top 2-10 and top 11-50 portfolios are significantly worse than the bitcoin strategy, while the best results we see in the top 101-500 portfolios but they also show greater risks than bitcoin strategy and require a bigger capital.

articleTitle: Two-criteria Continuously Repetitive Decision-Making Problem Under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: For a multi-criteria problem, the KL-guaranteed solution is analogous to the minimax for a single-criteria problem. Sufficient conditions for the existence of a KL-guaranteed solution have been found.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Efficiency of Economic Activity in the Field of Information and Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The efficiency of economic activity in the field of information and communication is evaluated. Efficiency is understood as the ratio of the output achieved to the optimal possible with the available resources. The econometric model of the stochastic frontier is used to evaluate the effectiveness. The model is estimated according to the 2017–2019 data of the regions of Russia and the country as a whole.

articleTitle: Planning a Complex of Works with Heterogeneous Resources under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of distributing a heterogeneous set of resources is considered when planning a complex set of jobs, consisting of basic and urgent tasks (with indefinite request moments). A method has been developed for constructing an admissible schedule of the main jobs, which is minimally subject to change due to requests for urgent jobs.

articleTitle: Dynamic Smoothing of the Program Motions for Single-Channel Electromechanical Control Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: For a single-channel electromechanical control plant, we have developed a dynamic generator to handle non-smooth program motions, simplifying the planning of realizable trajectories. The generator generates a smooth motion reference signal in real time while tracking an initial step signal, subject to the velocity and acceleration constraints of the control plant.

articleTitle: The Level of Public Consciousness In the Models of Society Development
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A simple mathematical model examines the interrelation of three socio-economic formations - capitalism, socialism and communism. The authors introduce the factor of the public consciousness level. Its growth is a necessary condition for the transition to communism. However, the acceleration of the movement towards communism today requires a reduction in social wealth.

articleTitle: Brain-Computer Interface Based on Operator Blinks to Control the Drone
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The progress in the development of robotics in the last decade around the world allows us to say that today this field of science is very relevant. The list of problems still includes the issues of control signal transmission - including the possibility of using various neural interfaces, such as oculographic, based on electroencephalogram signals, exoskeleton and others is actively investigated. The work investigates the possibility of reading the operator's control signal in the form of blinks by means of the electroencephalogram. The authors present a scheme of the approach, a description of the software prototype and examples of its operation. The study has shown that the approach of transmitting a control signal through the operator's eye blinks using a brain-computer interface allows you to control the robot in real time. This development can be applied to create a control system for an unmanned aerial vehicle or other robot.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of the Neurocomputer Interface Based on the Activity Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Under the system of human-machine interaction (we will further designate it by the word “system”), we will understand the totality of three interconnected components: a person (computer user), a computer and an BCI. The BCI includes a software and hardware complex (SHC) and information coming from the brain, most often in the form of electrical signals - electroencephalograms (EEG). The SHC currently operates mainly on the principle of “stimulus - reaction”, the stimulus is a signal coming from the user, in response to it, the software of the SHC provides the generation of a certain reaction. This procedure corresponds to the reactivity paradigm. At the same time, in the vast majority of cases, when the SHC was replaced by a human expert, the interface operation turned out to be more efficient. Therefore, it can be assumed that the use of the paradigm used by experts in the system contributes to improving the results of its work.

articleTitle: An Optimal Well Placement Model for Underground Gas Storages
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper proposes a model for optimization of production well placement at an underground gas storage (UGS), based on efficiency criteria that take into account the geological structure of the gas storage facility and the peculiarities of its operation processes. Test examples of solving the problem for a simplified model of an underground gas storage facility are given.

articleTitle: A complex algorithm for calculating the lower confidence limit of a large-scale complex using the information about the failure-free operation probability of its software and hardware
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Using the Bayesian reliability estimation method, this article offers an algorithm for calculating the lower one-sided confidence limit of failure-free operation the probability in a large-scale complex. This algorithm shows the main causes of contradictions in the results of software and hardware reliability control and ways to solve them.

articleTitle: Scenario Approach To The Research of the Possibilities of Agriculture Innovative Development in Contemporary Economic Situation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the study of the problems of improving the effectiveness of agricultural production state support under the influence of external sanction pressure. The results of a scenario analysis of the development of the engineering and technical service of agricultural production processes in order to ensure the sustainability of the industry and the possibility of its technical re-equipment are presented.

articleTitle: An Integrated Assessment of the Low-Carbon Transition in the Power Industry of Russia until 2050 under Accelerating Electricity Consumption Growth
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The study is focused on investigating low-carbon transition scenarios of the Russian electric power industry, with special outlook on the replacement of traditional energy carriers with electricity in heat supply and transport. The correlation between the greenhouse gas emissions reduction in the electric power industry, necessary investments, revenue required and electricity prices with an accelerated growth in electricity consumption due to large-scale electrification has been studied.

articleTitle: Trolls' Online Aggression Effects
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper builds upon the existing literature on Internet trolls to define them as social media users who system-atically express aggression online, and develops a computational model to study the effect of trolls on the aggression level on social media. We perform a series of computational experiments to identify the bounds for the effect magnitude. We also collect data on the online discussions on the Russian social media platform VK from 2020 – 2021 to calibrate the developed model. Our calibration results reveal that the most likely magnitude of trolls' effects on the level of aggression requires a double-size increase in the proportion of trolls for a single-size increase in the proportion of aggressive comments.

articleTitle: Digital Methods for Control Adaptive Production
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines the management of adaptive production preparation with the application of a numerical simulation technique for managing the flexible production preparation process, which is based on the analysis of how efficient automated production operations are according to various criteria that take into account the indicators of quality performance of the production operations by automatic machines. The simulation example provides the estimated cost and average cost of the robot's performing production operations for the three types of workpieces machined.

Author Keywords: analysis of how efficient automated production operations are

articleTitle: On One Approach to Elimination of Weak Inequalities in the Procedure of Convolution of Systems of Linear Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The procedure for cleaning weak inequalities in the Fourier-Chernikov algorithm for convolution of a system of linear inequalities is considered. An algorithm for identifying all weak inequalities of a system based on the Gauss method for solving systems of linear equations is proposed. The algorithm requires a polynomial number of operations. It is generalized to systems of inequalities given by multilinear functions.

articleTitle: Consumer Market Stabilization Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report is devoted to consumer market stabilization modeling. A macro description of the economic system's functioning process is given. A meaningful interpretation of the simulation results is presented.

articleTitle: A Model of Economic Dynamics with Labor Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The presented model of an economic system is the generalization of the Arrow-Debreu model for the dynamics case. The authors use the description techniques to develop an optimal enterprise by taking into account the dynamics of material products and financial indicators. They present a record of a multi-criterion problem and a procedure for coordinating the interests of industries.

articleTitle: The Concept of Joint Navigation and Communication for a Heterogeneous Group of Autonomous Uncrewed Vehicles Located in Different Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes the concept of joint navigation and communication for a heterogeneous group of autonomous uncrewed vehicles located in different environments. The theory of multi-agent systems forms the basis for this concept. The authors present a block diagram for a multi-agent system, a scheme of object integration based on the data from geophysical fields, beacons, and other available meters.

articleTitle: Approach to Remote Control and Detection of Degradation of LEDs in IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents an approach to remote temperature control of a semiconductor light source (light-emitting diode - LED) with an unknown emissivity of the surface of its elements. We developed a testbed to study the thermal modes of LED modules and verify the proposed approach. In the experiment, the values of color temperature, direct voltage, full width at half maximum (FWHM), and the surface temperature of an LED module were obtained and analyzed. Based on the conducted studies, the temperature values obtained using the thermocouple, and thermal imager differ by no more than 3 °C. This fact confirms the adequacy and applicability of the proposed remote approach to the control of the temperature of the LED modules, including smart ones (based on the Internet of Things (IoT) technology). During the experiment, the correlated color temperature (CCT) of the LED module increased by about 60 K due to the luminophore degradation and the increase of the radiation intensity in the blue region of the spectrum. Further studies imply laboratory and practical experiments on remote temperature control of the LED modules with standard bulbs and IoT lighting devices.

articleTitle: The Task of Choosing the Structure of the Crop Insurance Program
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of choosing a strategy applying for the crop insurance program. The insurance strategy under study is that the entire area on which the insured crop is grown is divided into several areas, each of which has its insurance parameter - the level of insured yield. The task is to find the optimal partition. The proposed strategy is evaluated according to two criteria: the total average income and the reliability of the harvest. The obtained solutions to this problem are investigated and discussed.

articleTitle: The Structure of the Flight Safety Management Systems for Different Participants in Aviation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work proves, particularly based on the results of mathematical modeling, the structure of the flight safety management systems (for the main participants of the aircraft life cycle).

articleTitle: Investigation and Development of Hybrid Intelligence Elements in the Joint Use of Activity Monitoring and Communication Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The practical issues of System Integration of methods for Data Envelopment Analysis and monitoring of modern Sociocybernetics in the context of developing Hybrid Intelligence and Assistive Technologies are presented. The application of improved methods of communication with the use of some original solutions relying on the promising idea of implementing “Stigmergy principles” is considered.

articleTitle: Anderson Discriminant Function Instead of an Artificial Neural Network for Evaluation of Class Posterior Probabilities
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a non-parametric approximation of the Anderson discriminant function and class posterior probability for solving classification problems. It is necessary to choose only one parameter of the weight function, in contrast to the many parameters used to solve the classification problem by the artificial neural network method.

articleTitle: New Algorithms of Generation of Mathematical Models of Electroencephalogram Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper we propose new approaches to the control of mathematical models of electroencephalogram signals, and also discuss ways to adjust their parameters. The developed models are based on the simulation of postsynaptic impulses using a combination of Gaussians with random amplitudes and mean values. The width parameter is estimated by calculating the convolution of the electroencephalogram signal with the Gaussian and subsequent statistical analysis of the results. The adequacy of the resulting model was verified using neural networks, random forest, and method of expert assessments.

articleTitle: Solving of the Cauchy Problem for Deep Bed Filtration of Suspension
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article discusses a suspension filtration model in a porous medium that describes the appearance of a precipitate. For the case when the particle capture coefficient is a linear function, an exact solution of the corresponding system of differential equations is constructed and an exact solution of the initial-boundary value problem is constructed.

articleTitle: Forecasting Ability of Hybrid Methods on an Example of Stock Prices Forecast using ARIMA/LTSM
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the research results of the predictive ability of stock quote forecasting models using the ARIMA/LSTM hybrid model. This study is based on a predictive power analysis using a sample of 30 companies from three sectors: energy, finance and technology.

articleTitle: Modeling the Influence of Nonpolitical Content on Social Media Political Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an agent-based model of political communication on social media and use it to trace the impact of nonpolitical messages on the flow of political communication on social network sites. We conduct a numerical experiment to compare the resulting model states. The results indicate that introducing politically neutral content helps alleviate political polarization.

articleTitle: Behavior Model of General Secondary Schools and Factors Influencing Their Results
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this work, the function of the educational result of the school, which is also a utility function, has been developed through a survey of school headteachers. The article considers four critical tasks of maximization of schools in the Russian Federation and obtains solutions to these tasks in a general and particular forms.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Robots in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article addresses the generalization of modern challenges to agricultural production from robotization and artificial intelligence (AI). The classification of agricultural robots is given for the identification of development trends. It is shown the possibilities of using agricultural robots and AI systems to improve the efficiency of agriculture in the field of crop and livestock production. Approaches to the construction and use of information resources for solving problems of precision farming and animal husbandry are described. The justification is given that agriculture robots are successfully used for solving the problems of complex agrochemical soil survey, recognition of plant diseases, weed, and pest control, cattle feeding, milking, etc. General approaches to the use of agriculture robots in the context of using the Internet are described. Methods and means of AI are considered mainly on examples from the field of animal husbandry, where they are used to diagnose behavior, proactively detect diseases in animals and birds, etc.

articleTitle: Social Financial Technologies for the Development of Large-Scale Healthcare Systems and the Russian Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed social financial technologies for the development of large-scale healthcare systems and the Russian economy, harmoniously combining the interests of working citizens, owners and the state, make it possible, at quite achievable growth rates of gross domestic product (enterprise revenue) by 3% per year, to ensure a 34% increase in wages of working citizens over 5 years, which will practically end poverty. To increase contributions to the development fund for 5 years by 16%, in which, first of all, the owners of enterprises and the entire workforce are interested, since this ensures the growth of their incomes and the possibility of constant modernization and updating of technological equipment and the release of new competitive products. First, to stabilize, and starting from 2026, to increase deductions to the Federal Compulsory Medical Insurance Fund and income tax, income tax and value added tax receipts and bring this growth to 30% by 2041, which will allow the state to solve problems of development of domestic healthcare and accessibility of medical services to the population of the Russian Federation. When switching to the social financial technologies proposed in the article, almost 4 trillion steering wheels will accumulate on the pension and medical personal accounts of Russian citizens in the first year of implementation. And by 2026, 74 trillion rubles. Providing citizens with 2% per annum, banks will be able to lend to enterprises at 2.5% with a 25% margin, providing the Russian economy with huge, long-term and cheap financial resources.

articleTitle: Breakthrough Technologies for Financing the Old-Age Labor Pension
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents a project for organizing the transition of Russian citizens to the financing of an old-age labor pension using personalized pension accounts. Based on the developed economic and mathematical model (simulation model) of the financial support of the old-age labor pension when implementing a breakthrough technology of pension provision based on personalized pension accounts, the simulation of the accumulation of financial resources in the accounts of citizens is performed, proving its effectiveness. Thus, with the introduction of a breakthrough technology for financing an old-age labor pension in 2021, in four years the average insurance pension per month will amount to 40% of the aver4age monthly salary, and by 2029, eight years after the introduction, the average monthly pension will amount to 60% of the salary in the corresponding year. At the expense of the funds accumulated in the personal pension account of a working citizen, after the end of his work (for the period of survival), his average pension will be at least 80% of his salary. It is shown by calculations that due to the funds accumulated on the personalized pension account, the amount of monthly pension provision of the employee increases annually, which encourages citizens to increase labor productivity (more wages - more amount on the personal pension account, the non-reduced balance accumulates faster) and the state to reduce deductions to the Pension Fund of Russia, and all enterprises to reduce the cost of production, thereby ensuring the accelerated development of the Russian economy.

Author Keywords: Pension Fund of the Russian Federation
